description: An MCP tool and a route that find other agents by the name you see in the sidebar. Ask for @Cv-Misc UI, cv_misc-ui or just misc and get each matching agent's id, provider, model, computer, project, status and available transport, on this computer and on paired ones. When two agents share a name the answer says so and lists both, so nothing is ever sent to a guess.
examples: A Claude agent asks agents_lookup for @Cv-Misc UI and gets the id of the Codex session carrying that label.
Two sessions are both called Twin: the answer is flagged ambiguous with both ids and the agent picks by id.
A paired computer is offline: its agents still list, marked disconnected.
An agent asks agents_lookup for a sleeping teammate (status asleep) and crosstalk_send wakes it, once the owner approves, and delivers the question.
how_to: From an agent with the carnivore MCP server, call agents_lookup with a query, optionally a provider such as codex.
From a script, call GET /api/v1/crosstalk/agents?q=cv-misc%20ui while signed in as the owner.
media_exempt: an MCP tool and an API route; it has no screen or control of its own
name: Agent lookup by name
summary: Find other agents by name, local or on a paired computer, any provider.
where: In an agent's tool list as agents_lookup.
